metadata.title: AI ASMR Video Generator with Synced Sound | Toolaze
metadata.description: Create AI ASMR videos with synchronized tactile sound, macro motion, and text or image control for cutting, crushing, pouring, tapping, brushing, and sleep loops.

hero.h1: AI ASMR Video Generator with Synced Sound
hero.desc: Turn a tactile prompt or reference image into a short ASMR video with close-up motion and matching sound. Describe the material, action, camera, tempo, and sound character, then choose the Toolaze video model that best fits your input, audio, and quality needs.

contentDepthNotes: Defines ASMR video generation above the fold with sound-first language.
Adds a visible What Is ASMR and What Is an AI ASMR Video definition section for informational search intent.
Adds prompt formula, model-selection logic, trigger matrix, and troubleshooting to match competitor depth without adding extra prompt cards.
Keeps four prompt examples and three Why Toolaze reasons per project rules.
Avoids unsupported claims such as unlimited free, no watermark, guaranteed viral output, or fake hard model limits.
competitorPatternSummary: Ranking ASMR generator pages emphasize synchronized audio, not generic video creation.
Strong pages answer whether text-to-video and image-to-video are supported, which models produce audio, and how users should prompt sound.
Vertical ASMR competitors split demand into glass cutting, soap carving, slime, tapping, rain, sleep loops, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and product texture use cases.
Comparison-style pages highlight prompt specificity, action verbs, and sound character as the main controllable variables.
